Frequently Asked Questions

Is CardCraftly completely free?

Yes. Every template, every download, every occasion — 100% free. No subscription, no watermark, no credit card.

Can I print the invitation I create?

Yes — the PNG download is high-resolution (3× retina quality) and suitable for both digital sharing and home printing.

How do I customize the text?

Just type in the heading, message, and footer fields. The preview updates live so you can see exactly what your card will look like.

What occasions does CardCraftly support?

Birthday, wedding, baby shower, graduation, Christmas, retirement, Valentine's, Halloween, quinceañera, Eid, Diwali, housewarming — and more being added regularly.

Do I need to create an account?

No. CardCraftly works with zero sign-up, zero cookies for tracking, and zero personal data collected.
